records.details: After idle close/reopen, Settings selector displays FollowWindows and surfaces render light, matching visible Windows shell. Optional publicJSON/local-first/no download or install disclosure readable. Requested150 not measured DPI; identity/cell credit withheld.
Notification unchecked, automatic updates checked; no resident monitor installed/notifications only while Nyx open disclosure wrapped and readable. No preference toggled.

Full update request disclosure excludes username,machine name,hardware identifier,file names,scan results,telemetry/application data; fixed public manifest HTTPS. Check for Updates button readable but not activated; prior UTC retained.

Full Privacy promise readable/wrapped: local unless explicit export; structural secret/usernames/email/IPv4/compressed-expandedIPv6 redaction by default; update checks never upload reports/inventory; local log rotation. Disclosure only, not behavioral privacy gate.
